newsitem.title: USA: Stocks off on profit taking; interest rate jitters.
newsitem.headline: Stocks off on profit taking; interest rate jitters.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell on profit-taking Monday after posting the biggest weekly gain ever last week and due to interest-rates jitters after a Federal Reserve official's comment that the possibility of "overheating" was the major threat to the economy.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 43.34 points at 6,660.21 after soaring 312 points last week. The New York Stock Exchange volume of about 397 million shares was the smallest so far this year.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by 2-1 margin.
